package.name: Workshop for FreeCAD
package.description: FreeCAD add-ons for making things, installed together: Workshop Parts (standard parts made to size), Workshop Make (getting a part made: setups, checks, fits, threads, slicing, cut and mill output), Workshop Electronics (KiCad boards and enclosures round them) and Workshop Documents (drawings, assembly manuals, patent figures, library packs). Each is its own workbench and works alone; tools for agents through Agent Link for FreeCAD when it is installed. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the FreeCAD project or the FPA.

workbench.name: Workshop Parts
workbench.description: Gridfinity bins and baseplates, project boxes and board enclosures, each made to size from a task panel.

workbench.name: Workshop Make
workbench.description: Setups, printability and review, fits and hardware, threads, slicing and output for print, cut and mill.

workbench.name: Workshop Electronics
workbench.description: A KiCad board read into the document as a solid, ready for an enclosure round it.

workbench.name: Workshop Documents
workbench.description: Drawing sheets, exploded assembly manuals, patent figures and library packs.
